div.head: Duns 2
div.ab: Æfre ymb IX niht gebyreð betweox ðam stæðum, þæt man oðrum riht wyrce ge æt lade ge æt ælcere spræce, þe him betweox bið.
Semper ad nouem noctes decet inter stationes, ut rectum faciat alius alii et de lada et de alia causa, que inter eos sit.

(Von Urtheilserfüllung zwischen Wallisern und Engländern. lq) Je nach 9 Tagen gebührt sich, dass einander zwischen den beiden Ufern das Urtheil erfüllt werde, sowohl beim Reinigungsbeweis als bei jeder Klage, die zwischen ihnen [beiden] schwebt.

(Of fulfilling judgment between Welsh and English. lq) Every 9 days it is fitting that justice be done to one another between the two banks, both in the clearing [oath] and in every suit that is pending between them.

Depending on [the passing of the] 9 days, it [should] happen that the rights of the each side on either bank are respected, both at exculpation and [any legal] communication which may take place between them.

note.seg: Be rihtes weorce betweox Wealum ⁊ Englum überschreibt Ld.
Be rihtes weorce betweox Wealum ⁊ Englum is the heading in Ld.

Wie bei Grafschaft, Hundred, Stadt, Dorf, so steht hier der Name des Ortsbezirks für dessen Bewohnerschaft, ‘those living on the two sides of the boundary stream’; Toller 909a vorl. Z. Vgl. Gl Rechtsgang 28

As with shire, hundred, town and village, the name of the local district here stands for its inhabitants, ‘those living on the two sides of the boundary stream’; Toller 909a penultimate l. Cf. Gl Rechtsgang 28
